about: One lighting setup per row of the lighting guide's quick chooser (docs/research/cinematic-lighting-guide.md). Pick the row whose intent matches the shot, then copy setup, quality, direction, color_temp, practicals and the finish default into light_look. 'stays_dark' is what the card must say falls into darkness. 'do_not_use_when' lists moods the setup is wrong for. 'low_key' marks setups whose setup text triggers the flat_light guards (negatives.json applies_when); the loop row is left false because its broad version is open and bright. 'board_url' is the Cosmos study board with reference frames. Direction words are a starting point: always name the side (frame-left, frame-right, behind, above).

setups.name: Rembrandt
setups.practicals: one lamp or window in background
setups.finish: natural skin with pores and fine lines, faint shadow-side bounce but no fill
setups.stays_dark: the far side of the face except the small triangle; the background falls to near-black
do_not_use_when: beauty shots that need open skin

setups.name: Butterfly / Paramount
setups.direction: key on lens axis, above, angled down
setups.finish: natural skin with pores and fine lines, backlit flyaway hairs
setups.stays_dark: cheek hollows and eye sockets; the background is dark or one halo

setups.name: Split
setups.direction: side light at 90 degrees, eye height
setups.practicals: one lamp, window or blind slats
setups.finish: natural skin with pores and fine lines, slight underexposure
setups.stays_dark: the unlit half of the face merges into a black room

setups.name: Loop, broad, short
setups.finish: natural skin with pores and fine lines, faint shadow-side bounce but no fill
setups.stays_dark: the shadow side of the face (short version); the background is dark or a soft gradient
do_not_use_when: the face must sit in a pool or silhouette
a graphic half-face is wanted (use split)

setups.name: High key
setups.color_temp: one temperature throughout (cool white or warm cream)
setups.finish: true-to-life colour, natural skin with pores and fine lines
setups.stays_dark: nothing large; only costume and small objects carry true black

setups.name: Low key
setups.color_temp: amber tungsten, or warm spark on cool ambient
setups.finish: crushed blacks with no milky shadows, natural skin with pores and fine lines
setups.stays_dark: most of the frame: shadow sides and the set fall to black, except one bright opening

setups.name: Window light
setups.practicals: the window itself, sun patch on wall
setups.finish: natural skin with pores and fine lines, lived-in set with dust and worn surfaces
setups.stays_dark: the room away from the window and the foreground nearest camera
do_not_use_when: the scene is at night with no window source
a crisp graphic shadow is wanted (use hard sun or split)

setups.name: Backlight / rim
setups.direction: back light or contre-jour, one side
setups.practicals: sun, window, lamp or stage light behind
setups.finish: backlit flyaway hairs, peach fuzz catching the rim, soft veiling flare
setups.stays_dark: the side of the subject facing the lens; dark backgrounds stay crushed black
do_not_use_when: the face and expression must read clearly
dialogue close-ups that need both eyes

setups.name: Motivated practicals
setups.finish: soft lamp halos that shrink with distance, natural skin with pores and fine lines
setups.stays_dark: everything away from the practicals: 50-70% of the frame in shadow

setups.name: Golden hour
setups.direction: contre-jour or low side, 0-10 degrees up
setups.finish: soft veiling flare, backlit flyaway hairs
setups.stays_dark: the shadow side of the subject in silhouette versions; shadows stay deep but not crushed
do_not_use_when: a scene that must cut with midday or night shots

setups.name: Blue hour
setups.practicals: streetlamp, table lamp, lit distant windows
setups.finish: navy shadows with detail, soft lamp halos that shrink with distance
setups.stays_dark: the ground and buildings in navy shadow; subjects against the sky go to silhouette
do_not_use_when: faces must read in detail without a lamp

setups.name: Night exterior mixed colour
setups.direction: side or top from street sources
setups.practicals: street lamps, neon sign, car headlights
setups.finish: uncorrected practical colours, crushed blacks with no milky shadows
setups.stays_dark: 60-80% of the frame: streets, skyline and the subject's shadow side
do_not_use_when: unmotivated cyberpunk colour with no signs in shot

setups.name: Overcast
setups.finish: lived-in set with dust and worn surfaces, natural skin with pores and fine lines
setups.stays_dark: nothing large; true black only in dark clothing or deep forest

setups.name: Hard sun / dappled
setups.finish: natural skin with pores and fine lines, slight underexposure
setups.stays_dark: the shadow bands and the shade; never lift them to see the face

setups.name: Firelight / candlelight
setups.finish: gentle flame flicker, brown-black firelit shadows
setups.stays_dark: most of the frame; only the pool around each flame holds midtones

setups.name: Top light
setups.finish: crushed blacks with no milky shadows, natural skin with pores and fine lines
setups.stays_dark: eye sockets, the room beyond the pool and the background
